summary: Paramount Skydance filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 30, 2026 the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California entered a States Consent Decree resolving plaintiff states' Clayton Act Section 7 suit and modifying the no-close order, clearing the path for its pending merger with Warner Bros. Discovery under the February 27, 2026 agreement. The decree imposes five-year theatrical release commitments, minimum film counts, screen counts, windows and streaming blackout periods. The merger itself remains subject to remaining closing conditions and timing risk remains the key arbitrage consideration.
